notes: The BASIC text-to-video graph for the wan22-5b-fp8 catalog entry (WORKPLAN 18 P7c step 1). It is AE_LLAMA_WAN22_5B_T2V_V1 with the diffusion loader told to CAST and nothing else: same twelve core nodes, same node ids, same links, same weight FILES on disk, same literal 1280x704 x 121 frames, same uni_pc/simple sampler and sigma shift 8. Two inputs differ -- node 37 weight_dtype (fp8_e4m3fn instead of default) and node 58 filename_prefix, so the two entries outputs do not land in one folder. Everything the sibling manifest says about the twelve nodes, the deleted LoadImage, the 4n+1 length grid and the translated negative applies here unchanged; read AE_LLAMA_WAN22_5B_T2V_V1.manifest.json for it rather than trusting a paraphrase.
whyThereIsNoFp8FILE: WORKPLAN 18 P7c step 1 was written expecting Comfy-Org to publish wan2.2_ti2v_5B_fp8_scaled.safetensors beside the fp16. IT DOES NOT. Measured 2026-09-16 against the HF tree API for Comfy-Org/Wan_2.2_ComfyUI_Repackaged/split_files/diffusion_models: the ti2v 5B ships in ONE precision, fp16, and every fp8_scaled build in that repo is a 14B variant (t2v, i2v, s2v, fun_*). A GGUF Q4/Q5 of the 5B exists in the community but needs a non-core loader node, which WORKPLAN 22a keeps out of the BASICS. So the fp8 here is a LOAD-TIME CAST, not a second download: core UNETLoader carries an advanced weight_dtype enum -- default, fp8_e4m3fn, fp8_e4m3fn_fast, fp8_e5m2 -- confirmed from the running backend /object_info, and fp8_e4m3fn stores the same tensors at one byte instead of two. This entry therefore adds ZERO bytes to a buyer download: its urls[] are the fp16 entry files, and a buyer who already has wan22-5b already has this.
whyItIsASiblingAndNotASetting: Same answer as the two H3 siblings. The catalog entry is what the panel prices, gates and recommends on, and these two entries have DIFFERENT minVramGB -- that is the entire point of the pair. A shared graph with the dtype swapped at run time via panelAdaptation.setInputs would make one workflowTemplate answer for two floors, and the gate a card is tested against would stop being a property of the thing it was measured on.
whyNotFp8e4m3fnFast: fp8_e4m3fn_fast additionally routes the MATMULS through fp8 rather than only storing the weights that way. It is a quality change as well as a memory one, and this is a BASIC -- the shape ComfyUI itself ships, not a tuned one. fp8_e4m3fn is the conservative half of the pair: it halves resident weights and leaves the compute path alone. Filed as a follow-up in WORKPLAN 18 P7c, not taken here.

prompt.note: reached by introspection anyway (the panel follows KSampler.positive/negative to the CLIPTextEncode pair, comfy-workflows/README.md); named here so a reader does not have to derive it. Note the NAMED input rather than a widget INDEX -- see whyNoResolution/whyNoDurationSeconds.

whyNoResolution: No procedural.resolution, for the reason measured on the sd15 basic and written up as WORKPLAN 18 P5a. procedural.resolution means 'this template derives its pixel dimensions from a MEGAPIXEL widget' (comfy.js injectProcedural), which is true of H3's ResolutionSelector and false of a Wan22ImageToVideoLatent that takes literal width and height -- those are injected by introspection, which is what the README contract promises.
whyNoDurationSeconds: No procedural.durationSeconds either, and that is the difference from the H3 manifest. H3 carries a seconds widget that its own ComfyMathExpression converts to a frame grid, so seconds had to be declared. This graph carries a literal numeric `length` on node 55, which is exactly what injectParams' generic frame walk writes to (comfy.js frameKeys = length/frames/video_frames/num_frames). Declaring durationSeconds here would flip lengthIn to 'seconds' and make the panel REFUSE a frames request against a graph that takes frames.
lengthIsOnAGridOfFour: Wan 2.2 samples 4n+1 frames and /object_info gives node 55's `length` a step of 4 (min 1, max 16384, default 121). ComfyUI does not enforce the step server-side, so a frames request that is not 4n+1 is accepted and rounded by the model rather than refused. 121 frames at the CreateVideo fps of 24 is 5.04 s, which is the clip a request naming no length gets -- unlike minimax-h3, whose authored default is a >15-minute job (WORKPLAN 18 P3a).

panelIntegration.saveNode: SaveVideo 58 -- mp4/h264 so AE can import it; filename_prefix is RELATIVE and distinct from the fp16 sibling so the two entries outputs do not share a folder
